Send email with attachments.

**Status:** Can't run yet (Coming soon): the node is listed under **Can't run yet** in the palette and cannot be added to a graph.

Sends an email via SMTP with optional data attachments. Useful for automated reporting.

| --- | --- |
| Category | [Reporting](../categories/reporting.md) |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| smtp_server | `smtp_server` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | SMTP server address. |
| smtp_port | `smtp_port` | Integer | `587` | `1-65535` | The run | SMTP port. |
| username | `username` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | SMTP username. |
| password | `password` | Password | (empty) |   | The run | SMTP password. |
| to | `to` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Recipient email. |
| subject | `subject` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Email subject. |
| body | `body` | Text (several lines) | (empty) |   | The run | Email body. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
